artifact_hash_note: Hashes are observations at collection time; only completed attempt artifacts are immutable result evidence.

interpretation.causal_scope: The baseline/PARX60 pairs are matched. Capacity comparisons that time out diagnose algorithmic tractability and cannot establish physical infeasibility.
interpretation.cg_certificate: Only certified_rc_optimal=true with exact_nonnegative_reduced_cost and zero artificial weight certifies the full conservative constant-rate event covering LP.
interpretation.integer_proof: The 600-second dedicated two-stage MIP proves only its saved finite pool; fleet and charging-cost stages remain separate.
interpretation.interrupted_pricing: pricing_deadline has null terminal exact reduced cost and is never a pricing certificate; its atomically accepted pool may remain usable.
interpretation.physical_validation: The dedicated driver reports route feasibility by construction and audits selected charging with the continuous half-open shared-capacity sweep; no independent continuous route replay is added.
interpretation.physics_scope: 236.44 kWh with 35.466 kWh reserve is a joint constant-rate sensitivity, not the full nonlinear 18E1 GIRO charging model.
interpretation.terminal_target: No 65% terminal floor or GIRO target is imposed or inferred.
